name: Cloudflare Zero Trust Free
free_limit: Free-forever Cloudflare Zero Trust / Access and Gateway for teams up to 50 users; includes private-app access and secure web gateway with up to 24-hour standard log retention.
watch_out: Cloudflare requires payment details during Zero Trust onboarding even for Free, with no charge for the free subscription. No paid-plan SLA; 24-hour log retention, community support and product-specific quotas. Separate from Cloudflare DNS, Workers and Pages.
